**Apple Silicon Macs only, macOS 13 or later.** Read the [⚠️ warning in the README](https://github.com/Temosh/onedrive-free-up-fixer#readme) before using it.

### Install

1. Download `OneDrive-Free-Up-Fixer-<version>.zip` below and unzip it.
2. Move **OneDrive Free Up Fixer** to `~/Applications` (or `/Applications`).
3. Open it once. macOS blocks it, because it isn't signed by an identified developer. Go to
   **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. The app has no window:
   it runs in the background and quits by itself.
4. Give it **Full Disk Access** under **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk
   Access**. When updating, remove the old entry (**−**) and add the new app again.
5. Right-click a OneDrive folder in Finder: **Repair & Free Up Unpinned Files** appears in the
   menu. If it doesn't, enable it under **System Settings → Keyboard → Keyboard Shortcuts →
   Services → Files and Folders**, or log out and back in.

Quit OneDrive before running it. Logs: `~/Library/Logs/OneDriveFreeUpFixer/`.
